By Ryan Brower

HEARST

Our product picks are editor-tested, expert-approved. We may earn a commission through links on our site. Why Trust Us? [...] ADIDAS' RETRO SNEAKERS (we're looking at you, Samba) are all the range these days. But we argue that the German giant's runners and trainers are just as impressive. Take the Ultraboost, a light-yet-cushioned sneaker that's comfy, sleek, and still holds up since first launching in 2015.

The newest iteration of the long-heralded sneaker, the Ultraboost 5X, was just released in July. And right now, during the 50 percent off Adidas classics sale, the 5X is 25 percent off the 5X until October 18.

title: Glastonbury Festival - 2017 tickets on sale in October
snippet:
As part of the Festival’s continued commitment to green travel,  our coach + ticket packages will – as in previous years – be sold in advance of the general sale. These coach + ticket packages will go on sale at 6pm BST on Thursday, 6th October, via glastonbury.seetickets.com, rewarding green travellers with the chance to be the first to secure their Glastonbury 2017 tickets. [...] The ticket price for Glastonbury 2017 will be £238 + £5 booking fee per ticket (children aged 12 and under are admitted free of charge and do not need a ticket). As always, the ticket price includes: [...] – Entry to the Festival, with over 3,000 acts across more than 100 stages  
 – Five nights camping (with no early entry fees)  
 – Free programme  
 – Free miniguide  
 – Free cotton bag  
 – Free mobile phone charging  
 – Free on-site newspaper  
 – Free mobile app  
 – Free firewood  
 – Kidzfield, where all entertainment, rides and activities are free of charge  
 – Support for Oxfam, Greenpeace, Wateraid and hundreds of other worthy causes (£2 million donated in 2015)

title: Amazon Great Indian Festival 2026 Sale: SBI card discount, Prime benefits announced, sale starts October 8
snippet:
Other schemes that have been announced for sale are Buy More Save More, Exchange Mela and Amazon Combos. These offers are intended to give extra discounts if consumers buy more than one product or trade in an existing device.

Amazon will also feature products in their Amazon Coupons, Freebie Central and the Customers Most Loved sections. These offers will vary in terms of availability and conditions based on the products.

## No cost EMI and exchange offers [...] Amazon has announced that its customers who are using eligible SBI debit and credit cards will receive a 10% instant discount during the Great Indian Festival.

The benefit will also be available on eligible Credit Card EMI transactions. However, the minimum transaction amount, maximum discount and products that can be discounted will be subject to the terms and conditions of each individual offer. [...] No Cost EMI and exchange options are available in various categories to customers who are interested in buying at a higher value.

Amazon is offering an upgrade scheme where No Cost EMI will commence from Rs 99% discount on qualifying purchases. Customer will select the product and financing option which will determine the actual amount of EMI, tenure & eligibility.
